hole_diameter = 3.0

hole_offset_from_end = 20.0

solid_body = Box(channel_width, channel_length, channel_height)
top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]

    hole = Pos(channel_width/2, y_pos, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(hole_diameter/2, channel_width + 10)
    solid_body = solid_body - hole

    extrude(amount=extrude_depth)

    (-plate_length/2 + corner_notch_width/2, -plate_width/2 + corner_notch_depth/2),
    ( plate_length/2 - corner_notch_width/2, -plate_width/2 + corner_notch_depth/2),

    ( plate_length/2 - corner_notch_width/2,  plate_width/2 - corner_notch_depth/2),
]

result = result + Pos(0, 0, plate_thickness/2 + boss_height/2) * Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_height)
